BEGIN;

-- Restore current_version_id column if needed.
ALTER TABLE course ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS current_version_id uuid NULL;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_course_current_version') THEN
        ALTER TABLE course ADD CONSTRAINT fk_course_current_version FOREIGN KEY (current_version_id) REFERENCES course_version(id);
    END IF;
END $$;

-- Drop unique index on compose_config config payloads.
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS uniq_compose_config_config;

COMMIT;
